source.retained: The contract is independently authored from fixed first-party documentation facts. No hosted OpenAPI payload, ee/ source, PostHog SDK source, or supplier documentation prose is vendored.

derivation.boundary: The complete documented public project-token runtime surface: POST /i/v0/e/, POST /batch/, and POST /flags?v=2. It excludes the authenticated management API, /flags/definitions local evaluation, SSE/workflow endpoints, static assets/recordings, and deprecated /capture, /engage, and /decide routes.
derivation.method: Independent bilingual PontxSpec reconstruction from fixed official documentation, accounting for every documented request field, query parameter, success/error response, dynamic map, documented constraint, and execution policy.

riskReview.credentials: A caller-local project token is required in every JSON body; it is never stored, logged, or sent to Hub.
riskReview.execution: Hub execution is disabled for all endpoints. Capture and batch mutate event/person/group data; flags can consume quota and use caller identity/properties. SDK/CLI must show a complete request preview and require explicit confirmation before sending.
